## What's new

- The Developer ID row is gone. MENU > ScreenScraper says "not in this
  build" again until ChaOS has its own ScreenScraper developer key; then
  it opens to your account and Sign Out.
- Box Art keeps using libretro's thumbnails meanwhile.

---

ChaOS 0.9.6 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.9.6-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.9.6-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
